cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our

construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement,
repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes
MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® - recognized worldwide for their deep
heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality. The
company maintains a global manufacturing and product development
footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2
billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people
is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across
all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of
being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed
decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. To
strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible,
we are looking for a Junior Project Leader (f-m-d) Engineering -
Milwaukee® Key Responsibilities: Lead and develop NPD projects in
EMEA in accordance with our development process on all technical
aspects for design and development Coordinate technical aspects in the
NPD Project for Professional Products EMEA or ROW driven Check
NPQ/PEAC/CTQs and coordinate results between Product Management,
Quality, Regulatory, Reliability and After Sales and prepare for EMEA
sign-off to provide a technical specification meeting to the customer
expectation Participate in the 2D/3D design reviews with Product
Management and Engineering Work closely with external partners and
vendors within the New Development Project Coordinate the Sample
Inspection Report with Product Management (EMEA), Engineering and
Quality teams (PRC) to support the pilot run approval and the
subsequent release for mass production Determine with team on
temporary deviation and releases Make technical file available for TTI
EMEA on product level and check integrity of the technical file Assess
and sign off temporary deviation for engineering if necessary, during
mass production Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
technical education, preferably in mechanical or engineering or a
related field Ideally experience in project management and product
development Good understanding of technical processes in engineering
like product development, technical documentation Ideally experienced
in Personal Protective Equipment or Power Tools business Excellent
command of German and English, both written and spoken, another
European language is of advantage Extensive experience with MS Office
application Knowledge in CAD system Willingness to travel according to
business need (20% approx.) Your perks: An interesting position with
an attractive company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu
Company pension scheme Free parking spaces directly next to the office
and good public transport connections Fresh fruit, water and hot
beverages for free Company fitness via "EGYM Wellpass" EAP (mental
support for employees) Learning platforms such as "GoodHabitz" and
"Learn TTI" for your professional development Special employee
benefits via "Family & Friends" and additional corporate benefits Are
you interested? If you like wild growth and working with happy,
enthusiastic over-achievers, you will enjoy your career with us! Send
your application stating your earliest possible starting date and your
salary expectations to jobs@tti-emea.com or apply directly via our
careers page . Naturally, we will treat your application with the
utmost discretion. We look forward to getting to know you! Techtronic

Randstad is one of the world's leading talent companies with the
ambition to be the world's most equitable and specialized talent
company. Through our "partner for talent" corporate strategy, we find,
develop and connect specialized talents with companies - worldwide,
locally and always at a high speed. We build high-quality, diverse,
and agile teams, while individuals can enjoy a rewarding career path
with equitable opportunities.

Randstad Professional is one of Randstad's four specializations
and focuses on the placement of specialists and managers in the
future-oriented sectors of IT, Engineering, Life Science and Office.

Our mission: We bring people together! We are currently offering an
attractive position as CTSU trial manager with one of our customers

- a pharmaceutical company in Biberach. A fair compensation and
personal support are of course included. You have a master's
degree in natural science? Then you are a perfect match for us – we
look forward to hearing from you! Apply online now! We welcome
applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of any
disabilities.
- Responsible for global Supply Chain activities for Investigational
Medicinal Products (IMPs) of national and international Phase I-IV
clinical trials in the Therapeutic Area General Medicine
- Function as the main point of contact to Clinical Operations and
Clinical Development for assigned trials, ensuring the timely and cost
efficient provision of clinical supplies
- Act as the responsible leader of the CTSU trial team within the
matrix structure, ensuring cross-functional collaboration and
development of interfaces for all Supply Chain activities on the basis
of business, regulatory and industry needs
- Provide input to clinical trial protocols and bulk demands incl.
comparator and non-IMP commercial products, to specific packaging
designs and efficient distribution strategies
- Support investigations as Subject Matter Expert for assigned trials
- Master's degree in natural sciences or similar disciplines or
completed vocational training with experience in clinical trials
- Several years experiences in clinical trial supplies or related
business
- Experience in working in an international environment, as well as
team leading and project management experiences
- Ideally good knowledge and understanding of the regulatory and
GMP/GCP requirements for IMPs
- Ability to interpret complex project requirements
- Good software skills (MS Office)
- Fluent English and good German skills, both spoken and written
- Strong problem solving capabilities with the willingness to make
decisions and the ability to drive results
- Very good communication, negotiation and presentation skills
- Ability to work independently as well as in a team
- Performance-based salary package depending on qualifications and
professional experience
- Extensive social benefits, incl. Christmas and holiday bonuses
- Company pension scheme contribution after the end of the
probationary period
- Up to 30 days vacation per year
- Option of permanent employment with our business partner
- A wide range of employee benefits/perks

Job Description EuroChem is one of the leading manufacturers of
fertilizers, with a long-standing presence in Europe and many
countries overseas. With our broad product portfolio, we offer plant
nutrition solutions for every application, including field
fertilization, fertigation, and foliar fertilization. The Supply &
Operations Planning Manager is a central integrator between the
production site and the regional and local Sales organizations. As
part of the regional team in Mannheim, you take full responsibility
for demand planning, supply balancing, and commercial scenario
development for a defined product group and/or a specific production
site in Europe. We are looking for a committed and experienced: Supply
& Operations Planning Manager (m/w/d) Your Key Responsibilities in
detail: Lead S&OP Planning for a Defined Product Portfolio or
Production Site Own the end-to-end S&OP planning cycle for your
assigned products/sites, ensuring a robust, transparent and efficient
planning process while balancing the interdependencies of continuous
fertilizer production, customer service, production stability,
logistics constraints, working capital and financial performance
Integrate commercial priorities into the planning process by
evaluating business opportunities, optimizing contribution margins,
prioritizing markets and ensuring the optimal deployment of
constrained production capacities Facilitate commercial
decision-making in close collaboration with the Commercial Lead
(responsible for the production site or the European commercial
organization) Commercial & Operational Planning Validate demand
forecasts, evaluate commercial opportunities, identify supply gaps or
surpluses and align production capabilities with Sales Managers and
the Commercial Lead Allocation & prioritization: Define & adjust
product allocations and market priorities (planned product volume/
price-positions) in close collaboration with Sales and Supply Chain
Execution to establish delivery commitments and operational priorities
Support working capital optimization by incorporating Order-to-Cash
(OTC) cycle-time considerations into planning decisions using sales
input and historical performance data Inventory, Production & Shipment
Monitoring Tracking regional inventory targets to balance service
levels, production stability and capital efficiency Monitor the
Production–Shipment Plan (actual vs. planned performance), identify
deviations early and initiate necessary corrective actions, such as
accelerated delivery or reallocation of volumes Your Qualification:
Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial
Engineering or comparable field 2 to 5 years professional work
experience in Supply Chain Planning would be an advantage Strong
analytical and commercial thinking skills; ability to balance
trade-offs and drive decisions Structured, proactive and hands-on
approach in dynamic environments Very good communication and
stakeholder management skills High IT affinity; strong Excel skills;
experience with S&OP planning tools is a plus Fluent English (written
and spoken); additional languages are beneficial Enjoy working in a
collaborative, supportive team culture Kontakt Like to work
independently and on your own responsibility? Entrepreneurial thinking
and acting is a matter of course for you? Then we should get to know
each other! Please send your detailed CV in English to Human
Resources, attention Andreas Wagner Andreas.Wagner@eurochem.group

About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards a greener future,
the demand for raw materials—minerals and metals—is set to
increase immensely over the next three decades. Europe faces a
critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these essential
resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps in. EIT
RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. Tasks Information Management &
Architecture Design, implement, and continuously improve the
organization's information and document management architecture. Own
the Microsoft 365 and SharePoint information management environment.
Ensure integration with ERP, CRM, business applications, and the wider
IT landscape. Define information architecture, metadata, taxonomy,
access controls, and governance standards. Ensure scalable, secure,
and future-ready information management solutions. Document Management
& Governance Lead the development and operation of the Document
Management System (DMS). Establish governance for document
organization, metadata, permissions, lifecycle management, and
information classification. Define standards for document storage,
retrieval, version control, and collaboration. Ensure information
remains accessible, structured, and compliant throughout its
lifecycle. Compliance & Process Automation Translate legal,
regulatory, and business requirements into effective information
management solutions. Manage document retention, archiving, and
records management processes. Ensure compliant, audit-ready
information storage and governance. Design and optimize automated
workflows, approvals, electronic signatures, and lifecycle processes.
Drive continuous improvements in efficiency and user experience using
Microsoft 365 technologies. Digital Workplace & User Enablement Own
information management and digital workplace solutions within IT
Operations. Promote best practices for collaboration, document
management, and knowledge sharing. Evaluate and implement enhancements
that improve governance and usability. Deliver training, user
documentation, onboarding materials, and guidance for Microsoft 365,
SharePoint, DMS platforms, and emerging technologies such as Copilot.
Vendor Management & Security Manage implementation partners,
consultants, and external service providers. Ensure solution quality,
governance, security, and alignment with business objectives. Oversee
implementations, enhancements, and ongoing solution performance.
Ensure compliance with IT security standards, ISO 27001, and
information governance requirements. Collaborate with security, legal,
and compliance teams to mitigate information risks and embed privacy
and security by design. Profile Strong experience in designing
information architectures and document management solutions, including
structured storage, collaboration, and lifecycle concepts. · Hands-on
expertise in Microsoft 365, particularly SharePoint, with familiarity
in modern tools such as Copilot Studio or comparable platforms. ·
Solid understanding of data structures, metadata models, and access
management concepts, with the ability to design scalable and
user-friendly solutions. · Experience in establishing governance
frameworks and applying "compliance-by-design” principles within
systems and processes. · Good understanding of system integrations
and application landscapes, including how to connect information
management solutions with business systems (e.g. ERP, databases, SaaS
tools). · Proven ability to design and implement automated workflows
and digital processes, improving efficiency and standardisation. ·
Experience in driving user adoption and delivering
training/enablement, ensuring effective and consistent usage of
systems across the organisation. · Experience in working with
external vendors or implementation partners, ensuring quality delivery
and alignment with requirements. · Awareness of information security,
data protection, and risk mitigation practices, and ability to
incorporate them into system design. · Excellent communication
skills, with the ability to act as the central coordination point
between business stakeholders and external IT providers for
information management and governance activities. Additional
Information & Our Recruitment Process Commitment to Diversity : EIT
RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage
applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.
Employment Type : Fixed-term contract with the possibility of
extension. Position Location: Berlin, Germany & Riga, Latvia The
position will stay open until a successful candidate is chosen.
Application Review: Our team thoroughly reviews each application.
Please make sure to submit your CV in English. Initial Interview (30
minutes): Meet with the hiring manager and recruitment team. Second
Interview (60 minutes): Second interview with a presentation on a
relevant topic to the hiring manager and the HR team. Offer : If
successful, receive an offer to join our team. Additional contact
details Contact Shushanik Sargsyan Talent, People and Culture
Specialist

About us JUNA is on a mission to #electrifyroadfreight. Founded in
2023, we’ve had a strong start and have already deployed a
significant fleet of heavy-duty electric trucks in Europe. Our
innovative business model makes it easy and low-risk for carriers to
shift to electric logistics by offering electric trucks as a service,
a flexible pay-per-kilometer pricing structure, and access to
guaranteed utilization from large shippers. As a joint venture between
industry leaders Scania and sennder, JUNA gives customers access to
premium electric trucks and reliable revenue through access to
priority green freight. Your mission As JUNA’s (Senior) Finance
Manager, you will own the full reporting cycle across our European
entities — ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of
financial information as we scale. You’ll work closely with external
accounting partners in multiple countries and oversee monthly
shareholder reporting. Take ownership & drive the month-end closing
process by preparing and reviewing key accounting information and
collaborating closely with external accountants to finalize the
monthly financial records. Prepare monthly accruals. Support in
preparing monthly shareholder reporting (e.g. OPEX, Vehicle P&L).
Manage communications with external accounting offices in Italy,
Netherlands, Poland, Belgium, France, and Spain. Assist external
accountants with preparation of annual reports and third-party audits.
Prepare & issue client invoices, track payment status and proactively
follow up on overdue payments. Continuously improve, streamline and
automate finance processes to drive scalability of the finance
function. What That Looks Like In the first 3–6 months: Ramp Up
Quickly: Become fully onboarded into JUNA’s finance systems and
tools, building a solid understanding of our entity structure and
reporting flows. Own Core Processes: Independently complete your first
solo month-end close accurately and on time. Build Key Relationships:
Establish reliable, trust-based working relationships with our
external accounting offices across Europe. After 12 months: Seamless
Collaboration: Work in sync with external accounting teams across all
JUNA entities, ensuring smooth coordination and minimal friction.
Trusted Owner: Be recognized as a proactive, reliable owner of the
full reporting cycle and balance sheet — the go-to person for
financial accuracy and compliance. Process Champion: Have identified
and implemented improvements to finance workflows, contributing
meaningfully to JUNA’s operational scalability. Your profile What
you bring: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field,
coupled with 7+ years of professional experience in a relevant role.
Comfort working with external accounting partners across multiple
jurisdictions. Proficiency with accounting software and ERP systems;
experience with consolidation tools is a plus. Professional fluency in
English required; German at B2 level or above. Who you are: Sharp and
detail-oriented — you catch errors before they become problems and
take pride in numerical accuracy. Proactive and structured — you
manage your workload independently and flag issues early rather than
waiting to be asked. Reliable under deadlines — you understand that
close cycles have hard stops and you plan accordingly. Analytical
mindset — you don’t just process numbers, you understand what they
mean and can explain variances clearly. Collaborative spirit — you
work well with external partners and internal stakeholders across
different countries and functions. Bonus points if you have:
Experience with multi-entity set-up. Exposure to scaling finance
functions in a startup or fast-growth environment. Familiarity with
IFRS in addition to HGB. Experience with MOSS, Zoho Books and Atlar.
Why us? Leadership and Innovation: Work with a pioneering team
dedicated to transforming road logistics and contributing to a
sustainable future. Autonomy and Impact: We value innovation and give
you the freedom to grow in our team to make a significant impact.
Sustainability: Join a company where your work directly contributes to
reducing carbon emissions in logistics. Benefits : Join a great team
in our dog-friendly, hybrid work model with an office located at the
heart of Kreuzberg, where you’ll enjoy a relaxed, no-micromanagement
culture, regular company events, access to Urban Sports Club and L&D
budget, and an office stocked with snacks and drinks to keep you
energized. Our Company Values Think outside the truck: challenge the
internal-only status quo, prototype fast. Impact, not activity: cut
through noise, prioritize what actually matters. Own it: end-to-end
roadmap ownership, no safety net. Collaboration drives the core: daily
work with engineers, CEO, and CTO. Customer in the driver's seat:
internal or external, understand what they need. --- At JUNA, we value
authenticity, humility, and potential — so even if you don’t check
every box, we encourage you to apply. We know that diverse
backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences are what drive true
innovation. Our team is collaborative, international, and always
evolving. Come as you are — we’re excited to meet you and
hopefully welcome you on our journey to transform the logistics
industry across Europe. If you require accommodation during the hiring
process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to
mikaela.roennkvist@juna.com. Please only contact this email for
accommodation purposes.

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking a proactive,
detail-oriented and experienced Senior HR Manager (m/f/d) to join our
team in Berlin. This role will be responsible for leading key people,
compliance, and governance activities across the employee lifecycle,
ensuring that HR practices are legally compliant, operationally
effective, and aligned with organisational objectives. Acting as a
trusted advisor to managers and employees, the role provides expert
guidance on employment and employee relations matters, oversees HR
compliance and audit readiness, and drives continuous improvement of
HR policies and processes. The role also leads Health, Safety &
Environment (HSE) initiatives, ensuring compliance with German and
European regulations while promoting a safe, healthy, and engaging
workplace. Working closely with internal stakeholders, external
partners, and legal advisors, the Senior HR Manager identifies and
mitigates people-related risks, maintains strong governance
frameworks, and contributes to a positive employee experience across
the organisation. This position is ideal for an experienced HR
professional who enjoys combining hands-on operational work with
compliance oversight and strategic enhancement of HR practices. Key
Responsibilities Employment & Employee Relations Support managers on
employment-related matters and people management practices. Draft and
review employment contracts, amendments, and employment documentation.
Ensure compliance with German labor law and collective agreements
where applicable. Manage employee relations cases, including
disciplinary procedures, grievances, performance-related matters, and
workplace concerns. Partner with external legal advisors when
required. Compliance, Audits & Risk Management Conduct regular
internal HR audits to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and
company requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.
Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions. Support
external audits and inspections related to employment, payroll, HR
processes, and workplace regulations. Monitor and communicate changes
in employment legislation and HR compliance requirements. EU Health,
Safety & Environment Lead and coordinate health and safety initiatives
in accordance with German and European regulations. Ensure compliance
with occupational health and safety requirements. Partner with
internal stakeholders and external providers to maintain safe working
environments. Coordinate risk assessments, workplace inspections, and
mandatory training. Support wellbeing initiatives that promote
employee health and engagement. Policies, Governance & Process
Improvement Review, maintain and develop HR policies, procedures, and
employee handbook content. Ensure policies are legally compliant,
practical, and consistently applied across the organization. Drive
continuous improvement initiatives across HR operations and employee
experience. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human
Resources, Business Administration, Law, Psychology, or a related
field. 5+ years of progressive HR experience in a generalist or HR
operations-focused role. Strong knowledge of German labour law,
employment regulations, and HR compliance requirements. Experience
managing payroll processes and working with payroll providers. Proven
experience conducting HR audits and implementing compliance
initiatives. Knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements
in Germany. Experience developing and maintaining HR policies and
procedures. Strong understanding of HRIS systems and HR data
management. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.
HSE certification preferred; candidates without formal qualifications
must demonstrate a willingness to complete HSE training Preferred
Qualifications Professional HR certification or relevant HR
qualification. Experience in an international or fast-growing
organization. Previous involvement in HR transformation, process
improvement, or digitalization projects. Experience working with audit
frameworks, compliance reviews, and risk management processes. Key
Competencies Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential
information. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to balance operational execution with strategic thinking.
Process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
Strong project management and organisational skills. Collaborative and
customer-focused approach. What We Offer Opportunity to shape and
improve HR operations in a dynamic environment. Collaborative and
international team culture. Professional development and learning
opportunities. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Flexible
working arrangements. A people-first workplace focused on inclusion,
wellbeing, and growth. Equal Opportunity Statement We celebrate
diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for
all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all
backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and are dedicated to
ensuring equal opportunities throughout the

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking an
experienced Head of Academies (m/f/d) to provide operational
leadership for the European Raw Materials Academy and the European
Advanced Materials Academy. The European Raw Materials Academy and the
European Advanced Materials Academy are flagship European initiatives
that develop the skills and talent needed to strengthen Europe’s
competitiveness and industrial transformation in the raw and advanced
materials sectors. Reporting to the Director of Education & Skills,
the Head of Academies is responsible for translating strategic
priorities into operational delivery and ensuring the successful
implementation, scaling, and continuous improvement of both Academies.
The Head of Academies (m/f/d) provides direct line management to three
Senior Education Managers who collectively lead a multidisciplinary
team of approximately 20 colleagues. The ideal candidate combines
operational excellence with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven
ability to scale digital education initiatives. Success will be
measured through learner growth, program quality, operational
performance, and delivery against agreed Academy KPIs. Key
Accountabilities The Head of Academies is accountable for: 1.
Operational Delivery • Translate strategic priorities into
operational plans and ensure successful delivery against agreed
objectives, KPIs, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and
compliance requirements. • Establish and maintain effective
operational processes, governance, reporting, and continuous
improvement across both Academies. 2. Education Portfolio & Digital
Learning Platforms • Lead the operational management and continuous
improvement of the Academies' digital learning ecosystem, providing
recommendations to support strategic decision-making. • Drive
learner growth, program quality, and an excellent learner experience
through effective operational management and data-informed
decision-making. 3. Team Leadership • Lead, coach, and support the
Senior Managers responsible for Operations, Course Development, and
Partnerships. • Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and
accountable multidisciplinary team. 4. Operational Performance &
Resources • Manage operational budgets within agreed frameworks,
supplier relationships, and procurement activities to support the
successful delivery of both Academies and ensure efficient and
compliant use of resources. • Develop, monitor, and report on
Academy KPIs, analyse operational performance, identify risks and
opportunities, and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. 5.
Stakeholder Collaboration • Maintain productive relationships with
internal teams and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment,
successful delivery, and sustainable growth of both Academies. What
We’re Looking For Required • Experience leading professional
learning, education, or workforce development programs. • Proven
success scaling digital education, EdTech, or professional learning
initiatives. • Operational leadership and program management
experience, including digital learning platforms and Learning
Management Systems. • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary
teams and delivering against ambitious KPIs and operational
objectives. • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder
management skills. • Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable
• Background in EdTech, professional education, or corporate
learning and development. • Experience building or scaling education
academies, digital learning platforms, or comparable education
initiatives. • Familiarity with EU-funded projects, Horizon Europe,
Erasmus+, or the EIT ecosystem. • Understanding of quality
assurance, certification, credentials, and micro-credentials. •
Working knowledge of additional European languages. What We Offer •
The opportunity to lead the operational scaling of two flagship
European Academies with significant strategic impact. • Join a
committed, mission-driven team working at the intersection of
education, innovation, industry, and European policy. • Work with
leading European universities, industry partners, and public-sector
organisations to help shape the future workforce for the raw and
advanced materials sectors. • Hybrid working environment in Berlin.
• Competitive salary. Position Details • Location: Berlin,
Germany. • Contract: Full-time. • Duration: Fixed-term contract
until 2029, with the possibility of extension. • Travel: Occasional
travel within Europe is required. • Reports to: Director of
Education & Skills, EIT RawMaterials. Commitment to Diversity: EIT

Ipsos Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. Ipsos Healthcare is the world's leading provider of quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the pharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The focus is on doctors, medical professionals, and, above all, patients. Our range of solutions is very diverse and covers traditional primary market research as well as scientific Real-World Evidence studies. In collaboration with our national and international clients, we conduct studies along the entire lifecycle of a healthcare product, from early demand and quality-of-life studies to projects for the preparation and accompaniment of product launches (including success measurements) and studies that help already launched products or approved preparations achieve greater success. We are looking for a Project Executive (f/m/d) starting January 1, 2027 for our Healthcare team at one of our locations in Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Nuremberg or Munich. Please note that this position is initially a two-year fixed-term contract. Your role You support the planning, coordination, and delivery of healthcare market research and innovation projects from proposal stage through to execution. You work closely with project managers, insights teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards. You coordinate external suppliers and partners, tracking project progress and supporting the management of timelines, deliverables, and documentation. You maintain project documentation and ensure that project records, specifications, and study materials are complete, accurate, and up to date. You support data management activities, including data validation, quality control, and preparation of deliverables using tools such as Excel and other reporting platforms. You contribute to testing activities for surveys, research platforms, and project workflows, helping to identify issues and support process improvements and automation efforts. You assist in monitoring project risks, resolving operational challenges, and ensuring smooth collaboration across internal and external teams. You act as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders, providing regular status updates and ensuring transparency throughout the project lifecycle. You contribute to the continuous improvement of project management processes, tools, and ways of working, including the use of AI and automation solutions. You collaborate with colleagues across Ipsos Germany and the international Healthcare network to support successful project delivery. Your profile You hold a university degree, preferably in business administration (focus on marketing/market research), social sciences, psychology, communication science, health science/public health, or a comparable field. You have initial professional experience in project management, market research, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, or a related field through internships, working student positions, or early-career employment. You have a strong interest in project coordination, operational excellence, and delivering high-quality client work. You possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to managing multiple tasks and deadlines. You are comfortable working with data and have advanced Excel skills; experience with SPSS, Power BI, or Python skills are a plus. You have an interest in data management, process optimization, testing, and automation. You demonstrate strong communication and stakeholder management skills and enjoy collaborating with suppliers, clients, and cross-functional teams. You are fluent in English; German language skills are a plus. You are proactive, team-oriented, and motivated to learn and grow in an international healthcare research environment. Experience working with AI-based solutions, survey platforms, reporting tools, or research technologies is a plus. What we offer At Ipsos, you can expect an international and innovative working environment. We serve renowned clients across almost all major industries and work on exciting projects worldwide! You can look forward to: Hybrid work Flexible working hours Workation in European countries Ipsos Corporate Benefits Subsidy for the Germany public transport ticket (Deutschlandticket) Job rotation opportunities Development & learning culture International collaboration Events & local community Diversity & inclusion initiatives Corporate social responsibility programs Modern workplace Interested? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your application (CV, certificates, and optional a short cover letter) including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations. If you have any questions, please contact:

As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:

- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.
- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.
- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.

What you bring:

- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.
- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.
- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.
- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.
- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.

What we offer you

- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work.
